clue.text: Black spider which is deadly — or worse, initially

indicators.note: initially tells us to take the opening letter of each of the five words before it

explanation.surface: A warning that a dark spider is lethal, or something even nastier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' takes the first letters of 'which is deadly — or worse', which spell the answer; the black widow is a venomous spider.
explanation.definitionFit: The black widow is the familiar venomous spider whose name is shortened to this word.

clue.text: Key workers in army outfits

parts.note: key workers suggests essential staff, but means jailers holding keys; army outfits suggests war clothing, as if the word split as war plus dresses

explanation.surface: Essential staff wearing military uniform.
explanation.walkthrough: Women prison officers carry the keys; the answer splits into WAR and DRESSES, which gives 'army outfits'.
explanation.definitionFit: Female prison officers are the staff who hold the keys to the cells.

clue.text: Edited fifty diaries of ex-P.M.

indicators.note: edited text is reworked, so these letters are put in a new order

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Fifty journals of a former Prime Minister are revised.
explanation.walkthrough: Benjamin Disraeli was a 19th-century British Prime Minister and novelist.
explanation.definitionFit: Benjamin Disraeli twice served as Britain's Prime Minister in Victoria's reign.

clue.text: Air hose provided for pilots

parts.note: air hose sounds like a tube supplying oxygen, but hose is read as stockings, a fabric sleeve filling with breeze for aviators

explanation.surface: Breathing tubes are supplied to aircrew.
explanation.definitionFit: A fabric cone on a pole at an airfield shows pilots the direction of the breeze.

clue.text: Goes on to make money

definitions.meaning: to go on or advance is the verb sense, third person
the money raised from a sale or event is the noun sense

explanation.surface: Someone continues in order to earn cash.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means continues or advances; as a plural noun it means income from a sale.

clue.text: A course for non-drivers?

parts.note: suggests driving lessons, but a course here is a route, one meant for walkers rather than cars

explanation.surface: Lessons for people who do not drive.
explanation.definitionFit: A footway is a route for pedestrians, who do not drive along it.

clue.text: C.O. in charge set about Sergeant-major — great!

indicators.note: set about means placed around, so the outer letters enclose the rank abbreviation

parts.note: CO is commanding officer

explanation.surface: An officer commanding sets about a sergeant-major, with excellent results.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set about' puts CO and IC around SM.
explanation.definitionFit: Cosmic, like vast or immense, can mean on a huge scale.

clue.text: Nothing more than a 50-50 chance, nevertheless

indicators.note: more than puts the letter for nothing after the odds, as an addition

parts.note: evens is betting odds for an equal chance
O, the shape of zero, means nothing

explanation.surface: A bare coin-toss of a chance, all the same.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means all the same or despite that, a synonym of nevertheless.

clue.text: Alert secret agent captures ringleader

indicators.note: captures means the agent takes hold of the letter inside

parts.note: a spy is a secret agent
the leader of the word ring is its first letter, R

explanation.surface: A covert agent seizes the head of a gang.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ringleader' is read as the leading letter of 'ring'.
explanation.definitionFit: Spry means lively and nimble, alert in movement.

clue.text: Like a shattering snore by a worker?

definitions.text: Like a shattering snore by a worker?

indicators.note: a shattering breaks the word snore into pieces, which are rearranged

parts.note: an ant is the classic crossword worker, from the worker caste of ants

explanation.surface: Describing the booming snore of a labourer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shattering' rearranges SNORE into RESON, and ANT follows; the whole clue also describes the answer, as a shattering snore is loud and booming.
explanation.definitionFit: A resonant sound is deep, booming and echoing, just as a shattering snore would be.

clue.text: Celebrated form of mahogany

definitions.note: the definition is a past participle used as a noun: something that is celebrated

indicators.note: a form of a word is that word given a new shape, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A famous variety of hardwood timber.
explanation.walkthrough: HOGMANAY is the Scottish New Year's Eve festival; 'Celebrated' is read as 'a thing celebrated', which makes a loose but fair definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The Scottish New Year's Eve party is an occasion that is celebrated each year.

clue.text: Eastern trail one meandered

indicators.note: meandered means wandered off course, so the letters follow a winding new path

explanation.surface: A path in the east that wound about.
explanation.definitionFit: Oriental is a synonym of eastern, from the Latin for the rising sun.

clue.text: Gains knowledge from books in studies at university

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it at university, so studies gives reads
being up means in residence at a university, as in up at Oxford

explanation.surface: A student learns from textbooks while studying at college.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Up' for at university is a British idiom: you go up to university and come down when you leave.
explanation.definitionFit: To read up on something is to learn about it by studying books on the topic.

clue.text: Superior lady with unmarried sisters in her care

definitions.text: Superior lady with unmarried sisters in her care

parts.words: Superior lady with unmarried sisters in her care
parts.note: sounds like a snobbish woman looking after spinster siblings, but describes the head of a religious house of nuns

explanation.surface: A snobbish woman looks after her spinster siblings.
explanation.definitionFit: The head of a priory, ranking below an abbess, has charge of the nuns.

clue.text: Strangely uncordial feature of wet weather

indicators.note: strangely means the letters of uncordial appear in an odd new order

explanation.surface: An unfriendly characteristic of rainy days.
explanation.definitionFit: A dark cloud bringing showers is a typical sight in rainy weather.

clue.text: In distress, daughter is told what to do

parts.note: to be ordered is to be told what to do

explanation.surface: A girl in trouble is bossed about.
explanation.definitionFit: Disordered, like disturbed or upset, describes a mind or state thrown into turmoil.

clue.text: Show resolution and reject pleas for disarmament

definitions.meaning: to show resolution is to hold firm to a position under pressure
read literally, someone refusing to give up their firearms keeps hold of them

explanation.surface: A soldier stands firm and refuses calls to lay down weapons.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to maintain one's position despite opposition, literally keeping hold of firearms.

clue.text: Might a pen have written it?

definitions.text: Might a pen have written it?

parts.words: Might a pen have written it?
parts.note: pen suggests a writing tool, but a pen is a female swan, so this is her final song

explanation.surface: Asking whether a ballpoint produced some piece of writing.
explanation.definitionFit: A final work or performance, from the legend that a swan sings just before death.

clue.text: Modelling nude, wary of making a move

indicators.note: modelling means shaping, so the letters are moulded into a new form

explanation.surface: Posing naked, someone is wary of moving.
explanation.definitionFit: Under way means in motion or in progress, so making a move.

clue.text: Flattery works with Eastenders, say

parts.note: soft soap is flattery, so soap alone can mean flattering talk
opera is the plural of opus, a work, so it means works

explanation.surface: A remark that sweet talk is what makes a TV drama tick.
explanation.walkthrough: EastEnders is a long-running BBC television serial set in London. 'Opera' as the plural of 'opus' is a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: EastEnders is an example of a long-running television serial drama of the sudsy kind.

clue.text: State benefit is about right

indicators.note: about means the benefit goes around the letter for right

parts.note: an asset is a benefit or advantage

explanation.surface: A government allowance is concerned with what is correct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'State benefit' reads as welfare, but 'State' is the verb definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To assert something is to state it firmly.

clue.text: Decorated about noon, has to deliver a speech

indicators.note: about means the speech word sits around the letter for noon

parts.note: to orate is to deliver a speech
N stands for noon, as in the twelve o'clock position

explanation.surface: Someone dressed up around midday must give an address.
explanation.definitionFit: Ornate means elaborately decorated, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Sort of oil possibly seen in holiday centre

indicators.note: in places the rearranged letters within the letters from the holiday
centre takes the middle three letters of holiday
possibly signals that seen may be arranged differently

explanation.surface: A kind of oil that might be spotted at a resort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'centre' gives LID from the middle of hoLIDay; 'possibly' makes NSEE from SEEN, and 'in' puts it inside LID.
explanation.definitionFit: Linseed oil, pressed from flax seeds, is a well-known variety used for wood and paint.

clue.text: Elizabeth includes us in commercial enterprise

indicators.note: includes means the name holds the following letters inside it

parts.note: Bess is a familiar short form of the name Elizabeth

explanation.surface: Elizabeth brings us into her trading venture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' looks like a link word but is part of what goes inside: BESS holds US and IN.
explanation.definitionFit: A company or trading concern is a commercial enterprise.

clue.text: Wide smile gives support

definitions.meaning: a horizontal bar holding up a roof, noun sense

explanation.surface: A broad grin offers encouragement.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both a broad grin and a structural timber that carries weight.

clue.text: Endlessly scrutinise the horses

indicators.note: endlessly means the word for scrutinise loses its final letter

parts.note: to study something is to scrutinise it

explanation.surface: Examine the racehorses without stopping.
explanation.definitionFit: A stud is an establishment or group of horses kept for breeding.

clue.text: Tight contest in which the winners manage to pull back

definitions.text: Tight contest in which the winners manage to pull back

parts.words: Tight contest in which the winners manage to pull back
parts.note: sounds like a narrow comeback victory, but literally describes a rope-pulling contest with a taut rope, won by heaving backwards

explanation.surface: A close match in which the victors stage a recovery.

clue.text: Many spoke but mumbled

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, which stands for many
to speak is to utter, so spoke gives uttered

explanation.surface: Lots of people talked, but indistinctly.
explanation.definitionFit: To speak in a low, unclear voice is a synonym for mumbling.

clue.text: Sound director made fun of

indicators.note: sound tells us the word for director is to be heard, spelt differently

parts.note: a guide is someone who directs the way

explanation.surface: An audio director was mocked.
explanation.definitionFit: To guy someone is an old verb for ridiculing or mocking them.
